name: Hierarchical Flood-Filling
definition: A bottom-up algorithm to assign correct signed distance values to inactive voxels outside the narrow band by propagating signs from active voxels within the narrow band. It uses the hierarchical structure to avoid cross-node propagation at the same level.
summary: Hierarchical Flood-Filling is a bottom-up algorithm that assigns signed distances to inactive voxels by propagating signs from active ones, avoiding same-level cross-node propagation to reduce overhead.
